build.system_package_mutation: none — build consumes existing tools only; npm ci adds no system packages

install_path.postinstall: npm run build:native — hard-fails npm ci/install when toolchain/headers absent (fail-closed stop rule)
install_path.verify: npm run verify:native — post-install smoke (flock acquire/release + SO_PEERCRED euid check) exit 0
install_path.escape: npm ci --ignore-scripts documented for pure-JS contexts; loader then throws fail-closed if native features are invoked

stop_rules_proven.no_silent_fallback: loader/build never substitute shell flock or PID files; absence = hard stop

limitations: deterministic hash holds on this toolchain (gcc 14.2.0 + same source); other compiler versions may produce different bytes — functional verify is the cross-toolchain check
socket._handle.fd internal accessor re-verify on Node 24 (carried from NM-009)
postinstall hard-fail means npm ci on a headerless box refuses to install — intentional fail-closed, --ignore-scripts escape documented
